audit.note: Every guide step below names the source it came from, with that source's date and link. Steps whose method no guide has confirmed yet are flagged unconfirmed. All sources were read and checked on 20 Nov 2026.

Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, and every step names its source beside it.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Budget roughly 200 hours for the full run, most of it after the story on the 100% completion checklist. Sources: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); Push Square puts the platinum at up to 300 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: The platinum pops once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it.
PowerPyx puts the full run at roughly 200 hours, most of it after the story on the 100% checklist.
Push Square says to set aside up to 300 hours or more.
One playthrough is enough and there are no online trophies; using cheats disables trophies and saving, so leave them off.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — Jason's first mission — and finish it. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); Push Square's story walkthrough.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission.
Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed — it unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1, Gone Fishing.
Unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1 and the chapter trophy pops. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the one spot tied to the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); KeenGamer on the Chapter 1 meditation.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1.
Automatic — it unlocks after completing the first main mission of Chapter 2, “What's in the Bag?”.
Unlocked as part of the story.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's story missions to the end. Like every chapter trophy it unlocks automatically on completion, so just keep following the story. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2.
Unlocked as part of the story.
The story is divided into 5 chapters and takes around 60–80 hours.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's story missions. This is the Vice City chapter, so use the time in the city to start the collectible and activity trophies that are available there. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3.
Unlocked as part of the story.
Chapter trophies unlock automatically as you finish each chapter on the way to the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 to close out the last full chapter of the story. After this only the final mission stands between you and the post-story free roam where the 100% checklist opens. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4.
Unlocked as part of the story.
After the story you continue in free roam, and everything needed for the 100% checklist is still accessible.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the only gold story trophy and it unlocks free roam afterwards, when the 100% Completion Checklist becomes visible (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); Push Square on the post-story checklist.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Complete the final mission.
Unlocked as part of the story; afterwards you can explore Leonida freely for as long as you like.
There is still free roam after the story, but no mission replay.
The 100% Completion checklist does not unlock until you finish the main story.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story mission trophies pop on completion, so play the mission through and it is yours. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
Unlocked as part of the story.
Story trophies unlock naturally as you play through the chapters.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist, so expect a big set-piece: follow the mission objectives and the trophy pops at the end. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Unlocked as part of the story.
Roadmap step 1: play the story, and take on side content as it shows up.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it is awarded for finishing the mission, nothing more. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Complete the story mission Child's Play.
Unlocked as part of the story.
Story-related trophies unlock naturally while you play the story.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Complete the story mission Headliners.
Unlocked as part of the story.
Story trophies unlock as you play the missions.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens, so remember the layout for later. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Unlocked as part of the story.
Story trophies are automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies; finish it and the story set is complete. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
Unlocked as part of the story.
The story takes around 60–80 hours across its 5 chapters.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only opens after the story ends (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). Per Shacknews (source: Rockstar Games) it asks for 100 story completion, 100 optional tasks, 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 30 unique races won, 15 meditation spots, 100 Cocaine Flamingos and more. It is the longest grind in the game — leave it for last and let the other trophies feed it. Source: Shacknews 100% checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Attain 100% Completion.

The checklist (source: Rockstar Games) asks for 100% story, 100 optional tasks, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 30 unique races won, 15 meditation spots, 100 Cocaine Flamingos and more.
The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts.
There are 35 tasks to complete in order to 100% the game.
The requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true game completion.
A Long Road is the hardest trophy.
GTABase splits the checklist into three parts: 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — every requirement can still be done in free roam once the credits roll.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and the like. Stunts count toward the 100% checklist too, which asks for 300, so keep doing them past 250. Find stunt spots on the map (Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots) and track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Source: Push Square (stunt spots and tracking); Shacknews for the 300-stunt 100% figure.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Complete 250 Stunts.
Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game; the 100% checklist needs 300.
300 of 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under the bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
See stunt spots on the map via Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots, and track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
300 stunts completed on the 100% checklist.
Stunt activities include base jumping and parachuting from heights and aircraft.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the 9 activity types in the game — the list's own count, confirmed by Push Square. Use the Activities tab (Touch Pad, then Activities) to see what exists and tick each type off once; you do not need to master any of them. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data) for the 9 types; Push Square.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Try each type of activity once.
There are 9 activity types in total.
Activities include golf, mini golf, pool, basketball, shooting ranges, races, drone races, video games, fishing, hunting, scuba diving, meditation and stunts.
45 activities catalogued, 41 of them confirmed from official Rockstar material.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Push Square names two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them on the map under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track progress the same way. Gold each challenge's target score — bring your best pistol and rifle skills, and redo the ones you silver until they turn gold. Note: GTA6 Database counts 12 range locations sharing the same 42 challenges, so the guides disagree on how many buildings that is — the 42 challenges agree. Source: Push Square (42 challenges, two ranges, tracking); GTA6 Database (42 challenges across the ranges).
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
42 Shooting Range challenges at two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero.
18 gold medals at Griffin, 24 at Rodgers Ranch — 42 in total.
12 range locations with 42 challenges between them, including a walk-through outdoor tactical course.
42 shooting-range gold medals on the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. GTA6 Database counts 42 drone time trials across those 14 spots, and every one counts toward 100% completion, so winning each location's race also feeds A Long Road. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then push for the win. Source: GTA6 Database (14 locations, 42 trials); Push Square.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
Top Fun drone races at 14 locations, 42 races in all — every one counts toward 100% completion.
14 locations; some require entry fees. View them on the map via Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
42 drone time trials completed on the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one you like. The 100% checklist asks for 30 unique races won, so keep racing past 20 and this trophy feeds the gold. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); Shacknews for the 30-race 100% figure.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Win 20 different races.
Track races via Touch Pad > Activities > Racing; most locations let you hire a car.
30 unique races won on the 100% checklist.
30 of 40 unique races won for 100% — keep racing past 20 and this trophy feeds the gold.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks Master of None if you have not tried fishing yet. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
Fishing is one of the side activities, alongside hunting, golf, mini golf, basketball and pool.
PowerPyx counts Cal's fishing among the optional tasks that feed the 100 optional tasks for 100%.

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and play one game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Complete an arcade game.
4 video games played on the 100% checklist.
Playable video games are among the side activities.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Side-character strands unlock as you meet the character in free roam and the story advances; check the map for Andy's marker when it appears. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame lists this among the hidden side trophies.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Andy.
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Several trophies come from character quest lines: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. These side strands are found in free roam, so sweep the map for Kenton's marker between story beats. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Kenton's strand is diving and treasure hunting — complete all of his diving/treasure missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with his final mission. Like the other side-character finals, it is a hidden trophy that pops when the strand's last mission ends. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Billy.
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Off-road racing includes races at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, the venue tied to Billy's side strand.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks-style mission strands scattered across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the game — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's strands all count — so finish any 8 and the silver pops. Hunt for stranger markers on the map in every region, not just Vice City. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); Push Square.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
Step 3 of the roadmap: Strangers & Freaks, then miscellaneous clean-up.
Step 3: finish Strangers & Freaks and the remaining trophies.
Stranger missions aren't part of 100%, but Strangers & Freaks needs 8 strands.
PowerPyx counts Strangers & Freaks quests among the optional tasks for 100%.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Watch for Randy's marker in free roam and work the strand between story missions. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Randy.
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
PowerPyx counts Randy deliveries among the optional tasks that feed the 100 for 100%.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. It is one of the five named side-character finals, all hidden trophies. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
PowerPyx counts Tyrone labs among the optional tasks that feed the 100 for 100%.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it, and KeenGamer names the spot — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating at Jason's house in the morning; follow her to the balcony and accept, and finish that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. One honest caveat: whether that Chapter 1 meditation is actually required for the trophy is still unclear, so do it anyway — it costs nothing. The other spots can be done any time; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18. Source: Push Square (18 spots, tracking); KeenGamer (Chapter 1 balcony warning).
trophies.missable_note: The only trophy flagged as possibly missable (GTABase, PowerPyx): one meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate there before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
Meditate at all 18 required spots across Leonida.

After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning. When she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation — complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1.
Potentially 1 missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude, as the first meditation is missable in Chapter 1.
Possibly missable: a Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia; everything else can be done after the story.
15 meditation spots completed on the 100% checklist — 15 of the 18.
Whether the Chapter 1 meditation is actually needed for the trophy is still unclear — do it anyway, it costs nothing.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting work and track down the unique animal he wants. Hunting is one of the side activities, so bring a scoped rifle, move quietly, and follow the animal's trail rather than charging in. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame lists this among the hidden side trophies.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
Several trophies come from character quest lines: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Bret's hunting quests are among the few 100% tasks that require everything: 15 of 15 Bret's Target Decks.
For 100%, study 100 of 255 animals by looking at them through binoculars — no hunting required.

trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; the 100% checklist counts 15 complete sets in total, so there are far more cards than this trophy needs — collect any 3 sets and the silver pops. Pick up every card you pass while doing other things and the sets will build themselves. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); KeenGamer (15 sets for 100%).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
18 collectible card sets in the game; 15 full sets are needed for 100%.
15 of 18 sets, 480 cards in total.
15 collectible card sets found on the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 different locations around Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app — open it at marked spots and let it register each one; the count is tracked for you, so work through the map region by region. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame (WAiNK scans guide).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: WAiNK It at 100 locations.
100 WAiNK locations scanned on the 100% checklist.
WAiNK scans guide: 100 locations.
The WAiNK app is also how you scan vehicles — 200 of 277 base model vehicles for 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are small in-game feats across combat, driving and exploration — browse them under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges, and pick the easiest 50 first. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep going after this pops. Source: Push Square (80 challenges, 50 needed, tracking); Shacknews (70 for 100%).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Complete 50 Challenges.
70 of 80 challenges completed for 100% — keep going after this pops.
70 challenges completed on the 100% checklist.
The 80 challenges come in eight groups of ten, according to PowerPyx.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Bring your partner along (character switching lets you play as both), cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies. It is a setup trophy, not a missable one — you can retry it any time in free roam. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame (needs both characters together).
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Every trophy is single-player, with none online — partner play is part of the story.
Free roam after the story lets you retry open-world trophies any time.
No online trophies; everything is single-player.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route of 3 close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving. Like Hot Together it needs both characters out together and is retryable in free roam. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Stick-ups are stores that can be robbed; the 100% checklist wants 50 of them fully completed.
50 of 91 stick-ups fully completed for 100%.

trophies.guide: Find and discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — driving or entering a new model counts it. The game tracks discoveries for you; vary the cars you steal and drive, visit different districts, and the count climbs on its own. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Discover 100 vehicles.
200 of 277 base model vehicles scanned with the WAiNK app for 100%.
200 base model vehicles on the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode) and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang shootout or a police standoff — enter focus with a full magazine, and chain the five kills in one activation. Retryable any time. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame (Combat Focus guide).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
The shooting ranges are the quickest way to grow Focus.
Free roam after the story lets you retry open-world trophies any time.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the trophy's own wording hints at stealing a plane and taking off without a flight plan. Head to VCIA, get a plane airborne by any means, and the trophy pops. Method not yet confirmed by any published guide (checked 20 Nov 2026) — the plane reading is the guides' best guess from the wording, not a confirmed step. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); HowToVideoGame lists it among the hidden trophies.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
Listed among the hidden trophies; no guide has published a confirmed method yet.
The airport area stays open in free roam, so the trophy can be attempted any time after the story.

trophies.guide: The Rhinos are the game's tanks — this trophy is about surviving or causing chaos in one. The description is deliberately vague (it is a hidden trophy), so expect it to pop from an extended encounter with a Rhino tank: steal one, or survive one's attention. Method not yet confirmed by any published guide (checked 20 Nov 2026). Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data); KeenGamer (trigger unconfirmed).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Kinda hot in these Rhinos.
Hidden trophy; the guide lists its unlock method as unconfirmed.
There are 28 hidden trophies and achievements in the game, many of them tied to the story.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean without ever being spotted. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when staff look away, and leave before any alarm. If you are detected, leave and try another store — it is retryable. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Smash 'n' grabs are places like jewelry stores, for quickly smashing glass and stealing.
34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs fully completed for 100%.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs are bigger than shop robberies — plan the getaway before you go in, and count each clean escape toward the five. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
8 vaults hit on the 100% checklist.
8 of 8 vaults hit, and 22 of 22 bank jobs fully completed, for 100%.
Banks like Fleeca hold marked bills, safes, and sometimes a vault.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cash and escape. Armored trucks patrol set routes — wait for one on a quiet stretch, block it, crack it open and lose the wanted level that follows. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
Armored trucks in the open world can be held up for what they carry.
Robbery proceeds feed the 100% checklist's fencing totals, including $250,000 in marked bills.

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida — the state the game is set in. Drive the whole map, including the outskirts and islands, and the trophy pops when the last area registers. The in-game map tracks what you have seen, so sweep region by region in free roam. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Explore all of Leonida.
Leonida is the state the game is set in, and its activities are spread across it.
Explore in free roam after the story; everything is still accessible.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map in free roam — hit one per gang and the trophy pops when the last gang's operation is robbed. Source: the official list (PlayStation / Xbox platform data).
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
39 gang operations cleared on the 100% checklist.
